action.command: su - postgres -c "psql -tAc \"SELECT datname FROM pg_database WHERE datname='xplanbox'\"; psql -d xplanbox -tAc \"SELECT count(*) FROM information_schema.schemata WHERE schema_name NOT IN ('pg_catalog','information_schema','pg_toast','pg_temp_0')\"; psql -d xplanbox -tAc \"SELECT count(*) FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema='xplan52'\"; psql -d xplanbox -tAc \"SELECT postgis_version()\"; psql -tAc \"SELECT count(*) FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema='xplanmgr'\"; psql -tAc \"SELECT extname, extversion FROM pg_extension WHERE extname='postgis'\"" 2>&1
